      Introduction

      Are you a skilled back-end developer ready to build innovative solutions in a fast-paced, high-impact environment?

      CtCtrlChain is looking for a Back-End Developer to join our driven and collaborative team. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, writing clean and efficient code, and contributing to the backbone of innovative products, we'd love to hear from you.

      Who We Are

      At CtrlChain, our mission is to revolutionize logistics by eliminating inefficiencies and reducing waste. We envision a fully automated logistics ecosystem where no carrier ever has to make an empty trip again. Through data-driven innovation, we are driving sustainable change in this critical industry.

      The Product Department is at the heart of CtrlChain's success. With four high-performing in-house agile teams, alongside dedicated Support and Data teams, our Product organization brings together around 50 skilled professionals — all committed to delivering innovative, cutting-edge logistics solutions.

      Why CtrlChain?

      • Innovation at Our Core - Building our own software is fundamental to CtrlChain's identity
      • Passionate & Industry-Focused Team - Our product team is made up of logistics software experts who are deeply invested in improving the industry and driving environmental impact

      Join us in shaping the future of sustainable logistics!

      What You'll Do

      As our Senior Back-End Developer, you'll be the engine behind our platform—building, maintaining, and optimizing the core systems that keep everything running smoothly.

      You'll turn complex problems into clean, efficient code and ensure that data flows seamlessly to the front-end and other services. With your deep knowledge of infrastructure and databases, you'll help power a platform that's fast, reliable, and built to scale.

      Your main tasks and responsibilities:

      • Work in a self-steering DevOps team
      • Take responsibility for solving problems independently
      • Create and implement software designs
      • Create, integrate and manage databases
      • Collaborate with other developers to ensure that the website and app designs work
      • Implement security and data protection for the platform
      • Deliver high-quality software
      • Be enthusiastic in developing knowledge and understanding through both interactions with the Development Team colleagues and the ability to self-teach
      • Collaborate to maintain the back-end functionality of the platform
      • Ensure that updates and deployments are delivered effectively within the agreed deadlines

      Requirements

      Who are you?

      • You hold at least a Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Computer Science.
      • You have a minimum of 3 years of experience with .NET Core programming.
      • You are experienced with Docker and Kubernetes.
      • You have prior experience with Microservices Architecture.
      • You are familiar with Agile Scrum methodologies.
      • You have a strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
      • You have hands-on experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD).
      • You are knowledgeable about RESTful services.

      Benefits

      What We Offer

      At CtrlChain, we believe in empowering top talent to do their best work. Here's what you can expect:

      ✔ A chance to be part of a fast-growing scale-up shaping the future of logistics.

      ✔ Competitive salary & benefits package.

      ✔ 26 vacation days

      ✔ Fully paid pension plan and travel allowance.

      ✔ Gym membership, daily office lunches, and team-building activities.

      ✔ An opportunity to work with modern, cutting-edge technologies in an innovative environment.

      ✔ A culture of collaboration, innovation, and ownership, where bold ideas are encouraged.

      Ready to Join Us?

      Be part of a company that's making a real impact in logistics and supply chain innovation.

      Apply now and help us shape the future of CtrlChain!
